checks: The three extremizing vertices can be chosen distinct within 3δ of the reference vertices. The signed determinant bound (1−6δ)²−(6δ)² is positive and gives the stated inscribed area lower bound.
The outer halfplane enclosure has area (1+4δ)²/2. Dividing by the inscribed lower bound gives h≤(20δ+16δ²)/(1−12δ)≤24δ, verified at the permitted radius by monotonic inequalities.

Among the edges of the triangle formed by three extreme vertices, one is a quadrilateral diagonal and two are polygon edges. The fourth vertex is across only the diagonal, so its normalized coordinates are positive, and the excess area ratio gives sum 1+h.
Exchanging the two shared-edge endpoints makes k≤(1+h)/2. Affine transport preserves all normalized quantities. Confirmed 39f4da3e2b2dd7eb opening and §§4–5 (11).
